title: Foundations: Worship Anthems - The Complete Guide
summary: What Worship Anthems is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Worship Anthems songs: Modern worship songs serve the Sunday setlist: vertical lyrics, arena-sized choruses, and arrangements any church band can play. Hillsong, Bethel, and Elevation write the global church's hymns.

History: From 1990s Vineyard choruses through Hillsong United's 2000s anthems to today's Elevation Worship and Maverick City, modern worship is a global songwriting industry serving local churches.

How the songs work: Worship Anthems favors the keys of G, D, A, E, C. Common forms include Verse–chorus–bridge, spontaneous tag; Setlist flow: gathering, praise, worship, response. Players should master the spontaneous moment: vamping on one lyric first, then delay-drenched lead guitar. Capo 4 in G is the worship guitarist's home.

title: Amazing Grace - Complete Public-Domain Song
summary: Full lyrics and playing guide for Amazing Grace, a public-domain Worship Anthems standard.
body:
Amazing Grace (Words by John Newton, 1779; tune NEW BRITAIN (1835). Public domain.) is public domain, so this record carries the complete lyrics — sing it, teach it, record it freely.

COMPLETE LYRICS:
Amazing grace! how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found,
Was blind, but now I see.

'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed!

Through many dangers, toils, and snares,
I have already come;
'Tis grace hath brought me safe thus far,
And grace will lead me home.

When we've been there ten thousand years,
Bright shining as the sun,
We've no less days to sing God's praise
Than when we'd first begun.

HOW TO PLAY IT: a Worship Anthems accompaniment in G using the 'Setlist I–V–vi–IV' pattern:
G | D | Em | C

Technique: the spontaneous moment: vamping on one lyric. Capo 4 in G is the worship guitarist's home.
